title: Co-repression of Yap1 and Sox9 abrogates established cholangiocarcinoma by eliminating transcriptional compensation.
authors: Kim, Minwook; Hu, Shikai; Park, Yoojeong; Kwon, Joseph; Molina, Laura; Wang, Li-Ju; Liu, Jia-Jun; Liu, Silvia; Singhi, Aatur; Chiu, Yu-Chiao; Ko, Sungjin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究胆管癌中SOX9/YAP1转录因子的共抑制治疗，虽涉及TF-DNA调控网络但核心是肿瘤治疗机制，非TF-DNA互作建模，AI仅用于预测辅助，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND/AIMS: Intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma (iCCA) represents an unmet clinical need due to its increasing incidence, aggressive biology, and limited treatment options. The extremely low-response rates to current systemic regimens and the emergence of adaptive resistance to targeted therapies underscore the urgent need for alternative therapeutic strategies. Given that the lineage-defining transcription factors SOX9 and YAP1 are central regulators of cholangiocyte and iCCA identity, we investigated their functional roles as potential therapeutic vulnerabilities across multiple preclinical models. METHODS: Patient tissue-microarray analysis, Sleeping Beauty hydrodynamic tail vein injection-based iCCA models, and Cre-mediated inducible gene deletion systems were used to investigate the roles of Sox9 and Yap1. Deep-learning- based prediction, RNA-seq, chromatin immunoprecipitation sequencing and immunohistochemistry analyses were performed to delineate transcriptional networks and downstream effectors associated with SOX9/ YAP1 signaling. RESULTS: Dual deletion of Sox9 and Yap1 effectively eradicated advanced iCCA while preserving intrahepatic bile ducts, regardless of oncogenic drivers. Mechanistically, SOX9 and YAP1 transcriptionally compensated for each other when one was absent, and ILF2 and MGAT5 were identified as key downstream effectors mediating this compensatory mechanism. Loss of Ilf2 and Mgat5 suppressed iCCA, whereas overexpression of Ilf2 following Sox9/Yap1 co-deletion restored tumor development, indicating that ILF2 can functionally substitute for YAP1 and SOX9 in sustaining iCCA. CONCLUSIONS: Co-targeting SOX9 and YAP1 offers a promising and safe broad-spectrum preventive/therapeutic approach for iCCA, potentially overcoming resistance to YAP1 inhibition. The adaptive resistance mechanism identified may extend to other malignancies, providing insights for addressing the advanced resistance to YAP1-TEAD-directed therapies.
abstract_zh: 背景/目的：肝内胆管癌（iCCA）因其发病率不断上升、生物学行为侵袭性强及治疗选择有限，构成了未满足的临床需求。当前全身治疗方案响应率极低，且靶向治疗出现适应性耐药，凸显了对替代治疗策略的迫切需求。鉴于谱系定义转录因子SOX9和YAP1是胆管细胞及iCCA身份的核心调控因子，我们在多种临床前模型中研究了它们作为潜在治疗脆弱点的功能作用。方法：采用患者组织微阵列分析、睡美人水动力尾静脉注射为基础的iCCA模型及Cre介导的诱导性基因删除系统，研究Sox9和Yap1的作用。通过基于深度学习的预测、RNA-seq、染色质免疫沉淀测序及免疫组化分析，描绘与SOX9/YAP1信号相关的转录网络及下游效应因子。结果：Sox9和Yap1的双重删除有效根除晚期iCCA，同时保留肝内胆管，且不受致癌驱动因子影响。机制上，当其中一个缺失时，SOX9和YAP1在转录水平上相互补偿，并鉴定出ILF2和MGAT5为介导该补偿机制的关键下游效应因子。Ilf2和Mgat5的缺失抑制iCCA，而Sox9/Yap1共删除后Ilf2的过表达恢复肿瘤发展，表明ILF2在维持iCCA中可功能替代YAP1和SOX9。结论：共靶向SOX9和YAP1为iCCA提供了一种有前景且安全的广谱预防/治疗策略，可能克服对YAP1抑制的耐药性。所识别的适应性耐药机制可能扩展至其他恶性肿瘤，为应对YAP1-TEAD导向疗法的晚期耐药提供见解。
